modules.title: How to Request a Baptism Certificate
modules.summary: Steps for a parishioner to request an official baptismal certificate online.
steps: Log in to your TUGON account. (If you don't have an account yet, click 'Register' on the login page).
In the sidebar navigation, click 'Requests' and select 'New Request', or directly open 'Request Certificate' (users/request-certificate.php).
Under Certificate Type, select 'Baptismal Certificate'.
Enter the record holder's complete name, date of birth, place of birth, father's full name, and mother's maiden name.
Upload a clear photo or scan of a Valid Government ID and the PSA Birth Certificate.
Choose your Payment Method: 'GCash' (send ₱100.00 to Agnes Calapaan at 0997 742 8176 and upload receipt screenshot) or 'Cash on Pickup' at the parish office.
Select your delivery/release preference: 'Online Release' (PDF download in system) or 'In-Person Pickup'.
Click the brown 'Submit Request' button and copy your Tracking Reference Number (e.g. REQ-2026-XXXX).
Track the progress anytime under 'My Requests'.

modules.title: How to Request a Confirmation Certificate
modules.summary: Steps to request an official confirmation certificate.
steps: Log in to your TUGON account and open 'Requests' -> 'Request Certificate' (users/request-certificate.php).
Under Certificate Type, choose 'Confirmation Certificate'.
Fill in the confirmand's full name, approximate year or date of confirmation, and names of parents/sponsors if known.
Upload a Valid Government ID and the PSA Birth Certificate or Baptismal Certificate as supporting record.
Choose your Payment Method: GCash (₱100.00 to 0997 742 8176) or Cash upon pickup.
Click 'Submit Request' and record your Reference Number for tracking in 'My Requests'.

modules.title: How to Request a Marriage Certificate
modules.summary: Steps to request a parish church marriage certificate.
steps: Log in to your account and go to 'Requests' -> 'Request Certificate'.
Under Certificate Type, select 'Marriage Certificate'.
Enter the husband's full name, wife's full maiden name, and wedding date.
Upload a Valid Government ID of the spouse or authorized representative, plus PSA Marriage Certificate if available.
Select Payment Method (GCash ₱100.00 or Cash on pickup) and Release preference.
Click 'Submit Request' and track status in 'My Requests'.

modules.title: How to Request a First Holy Communion Certificate
modules.summary: Steps to request a first holy communion certificate.
steps: Log in to your account and navigate to 'Requests' -> 'Request Certificate'.
Under Certificate Type, select 'First Communion Certificate'.
Enter the communicant's full name, birthdate, school/parish where communion occurred, and parents' names.
Upload a Valid Government ID and Baptismal Certificate.
Submit the form and track your Reference Number in 'My Requests'.

modules.title: How to Book a Blessing (House, Vehicle, Business)
modules.summary: Steps to schedule a blessing for a house, commercial business, or motor vehicle.
steps: Log in to your TUGON account.
From the sidebar menu, click 'Requests' and select 'Request Blessing' (users/request-blessing.php).
Select the Blessing Type: 'House Blessing', 'Vehicle Blessing', or 'Business Blessing'.
Pick your preferred Ceremony Date and Time.
Provide your contact details, complete address or location for house/business, or plate/model details for vehicle.
Add any special notes or directions for the priest and parish staff in the remarks box.
Click the brown 'Submit Blessing Request' button.

Wait for parish office confirmation. The staff will verify the priest's calendar availability and update the status in 'My Requests'. (Note: Blessings have no mandatory fee; voluntary love offering is accepted).

modules.title: How to Check Request Status
modules.summary: How to see whether your request is Pending, Processing, Completed, or Rejected.
steps: Method 1 (Logged-in): Click 'My Requests' in the sidebar menu (users/my-requests.php). You will see a list of all your submitted requests with live status badges (Pending, Processing, Completed, Rejected).

Method 2 (Not Logged-in): On the main login page (auth/login.php), click 'Check Request Status'. Enter your Tracking Reference Number (e.g., REQ-2026-0001) to view real-time status without logging in.
If your request is 'Completed' and you requested an online release, click the 'Download Certificate' button on your request card to download the official PDF.
If your request is 'Rejected', click on it to read the Admin Remarks explaining what requirement was blurry or missing, then update and resubmit.

modules.title: How to Request a Sacramental Service (Baptism, Confirmation, Wedding, Funeral)
modules.summary: Steps to book a sacramental ceremony or mass service.
steps: Log in and navigate to 'Sacramental Services' in the sidebar (users/sacraments.php).
Choose the sacrament: 'Baptism Service', 'Confirmation Service', 'Marriage / Wedding Service', or 'Funeral Mass'.
Select your preferred Ceremony Date and Time.
Fill out the candidate/couple/deceased personal details and parents/sponsors.
Upload required supporting documents (e.g. PSA Birth Certificate for Baptism, Pre-Cana certificate and CENOMAR for Wedding, PSA Death Certificate and Burial Permit for Funeral).
Submit the booking. Parish staff will review requirements and schedule the officiating priest.

modules.title: How to Reserve Parish Facilities / Church Venue
modules.summary: Steps to reserve parish hall, meeting rooms, or church grounds.
steps: Log in and open 'Reservations' -> 'Make Reservation' (users/make-reservation.php).
Select the facility or resource needed (e.g. Parish Hall, Church Sanctuary).
Select the desired date, start time, and end time.
Enter event purpose, estimated attendees, and contact person.
Submit the reservation for admin conflict check and approval.

modules.title: How to Generate a Certificate (Admin / Staff Workflow)
modules.summary: Step-by-step instructions for parish administrators to generate official sacramental certificates.
steps: Log in as Admin or Staff and open 'Certificate Generator' from the sidebar (admin/certificate-generator.php).
Select the Certificate Type: 'Baptism', 'Confirmation', 'First Communion', 'Marriage', or 'Funeral'.
In the unified 'Select Record' field, type the person's name into the searchable combobox (e.g. type 'Rey Mark' or 'Juan'). The list filters in real-time. Click to select the matching record.
Verify or adjust the pre-filled record details: Full Name, Birthday, Birthplace, Residence, Father's Name, Mother's Name, Date of Sacrament, and Sponsors.
Select the 'Officiating Priest' and 'Priest in Charge (Parish Priest)'.
Ensure all required fields (including at least 2 sponsors) are filled.
Click the gold 'Generate Certificate' button. The system redirects to 'view-certificate.php' where you can inspect the certificate layout.
From the view screen, you can print, download the tamper-proof SHA-256 PDF, or approve for official issuance in 'admin/certificate-workflow.php'.

modules.title: How to Change the Priest on Certificates (Admin Workflow)
keywords: how do i change the priest on the certificates
modules.summary: How an administrator changes the priest or signatory names on certificates.
steps: Open 'Certificate Generator' (admin/certificate-generator.php).
In the certificate form, locate the 'Priest in Charge (Parish Priest)' and 'Officiating Priest' dropdowns/inputs.
Select or type the desired priest's name (e.g., 'REV. FR. HERIBERTO C. VILLAS, O.M.I.').
For system-wide default template signatories: Navigate to 'Certificate Settings' (admin/certificate-templates.php) or 'Certificate Layout Editor' (admin/certificate-layout-editor.php).
Update the default 'priest_name' and 'priest_position' under layout static text settings and click 'Save Layout'.

modules.title: How to Update a Request Status (Admin / Staff Workflow)
keywords: how do i update a request status
modules.summary: How an administrator reviews a request and updates its status.
steps: Log in as Admin/Staff and navigate to 'Requests' (admin/requests.php).
Find the target request from the table and click 'View' or open directly: 'admin/request-details.php?id=[REQUEST_ID]'.
Review submitted requester documents, PSA attachments, and applicant details.
Scroll down to the 'REVIEW STATUS & UPDATES' section.
Select the new status from the 'Current Status' dropdown: 'Pending', 'Processing', 'Completed', or 'Rejected'.
Enter any remarks or instructions in the 'Admin Response / Remarks' textarea (especially if rejected, explain what was missing).
If it is a service/blessing, enter Ceremony Date, Ceremony Time, and assigned Minister.
Click the brown 'Update Request' button to save and notify the parishioner via SMS/Email.

modules.title: How to View Analytics & Reports (Admin Workflow)
modules.summary: How administrators access operational metrics and summary statistics.
steps: Open 'Analytics & Reports' (admin/reports.php) from the admin sidebar.
At the top, examine the 'Operational Summary' section showing: Total Certificates Created, Blessings Completed, and Sacramental Services Total.
Use the Date Range filter pills ('All Time', 'This Month', 'This Year', or 'Custom Range') to filter the metrics.

Review the three breakdown cards: Certificates Breakdown (horizontal bars by sacrament), Blessings Breakdown (status chips and completed hero count), and Sacramental Services Breakdown (status table).
Click 'Export Summary (CSV)' to download a spreadsheet, or use the header export buttons for PDF / CSV / Print Preview.
